deploy-bot: Starting container image push to registry.redwood.ai for service=inference-runtime env=production commit=a1b2c3d tag=release-2026-03-20

alice_gomez: kicking this off now, will follow up with status. tagging and pushing from ci-runner-5 :rocket:

ben_li: nice — keeping an eye on perf tests once it lands. :eyes:

deploy-bot: push step -> docker manifest create ok, uploading layers...

deploy-bot: ERROR during push -> HTTP 409 conflict from registry while uploading blob
```
The push refers to repository [registry.redwood.ai/inference-runtime]
Tagging a1b2c3d as release-2026-03-20
a1b2c3d: Layer already exists
Uploading layer: 12.34MB/56.78MB
Error response from daemon: received unexpected HTTP status: 409 Conflict
Error: failed to push some refs to 'registry.redwood.ai/inference-runtime'
Reason: blob upload unknown to registry
```

carla_nguyen: hmm 409 blob upload unknown — we've seen this with stale upload sessions. registry-proxy occasionally needs a GC or retry.

maya_kapoor: change window still open for another 35m. What's impact if we retry?

ben_li: retrying push usually works, but if it's an overlay/digest mismatch we should prefer pinning to a known-good digest or fall back to previous release.

oncall_sre: @carla_nguyen can you check registry health? please look at recent GC logs and active uploads. pinging registry-admin.

carla_nguyen: checked registry, no ongoing GC. Saw a flurry of aborted uploads 3m ago from ci-runner pool. Gateway returned 409 on chunk finalization. I can trigger a retry, but recommend pinning by digest if CI produced the image manifest already.

alice_gomez: CI printed manifest digest earlier: sha256:deadbeefcafef00d1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef
If we can push tag->digest mapping without re-uploading blobs that may succeed.

deploy-bot: attempting tag-to-digest manifest push (manifest put) for release-2026-03-20 -> sha256:deadbeefcafef00d...

deploy-bot: registry responded 409 on manifest put as well: conflict - unexpected layer digests

ben_li: ok two failures. Options: 1) keep retrying until blob upload succeeds (risk: unknown retry window), 2) revert and redeploy previous image, 3) coordinate a quick registry maintenance to clear aborted uploads and then retry, 4) promote the build from canary if available.

maya_kapoor: product prefers minimal rollback ripping. If we can pin a digest and validate in canary, that would be ideal. But we need a concrete plan in next 15m.

oncall_sre: If we do registry maintenance it'll take ~10-15m and a short window of degraded pushes. I can run it now and we can attempt a single retry. If it fails again, we roll back to previous tag.

alice_gomez: agree. @oncall_sre run the maintenance, I'll queue a single retry after you confirm. No mass retries from CI.

oncall_sre: starting registry clean-up: aborting stale uploads and reindexing. ETA ~8m.

deploy-bot: [automated] Pausing CI publish workers for inference-runtime to avoid duplicate uploads.

(8 minutes pass)

noncall_sre: cleanup done. aborted 12 stale uploads. registry health OK. Please retry single push now.

alice_gomez: re-running push (manual retry)

deploy-bot: push output:
```
Pushing manifest for release-2026-03-20
Layer abc123 already exists
Digest: sha256:deadbeefcafef00d1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef
Status: manifest put succeeded
```

ben_li: :tada: looks good. Can we verify image pull on a canary host before full rollout?

alice_gomez: deploying to canary pool (2 nodes) now, will smoke test.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started -> env=production-canary tag=release-2026-03-20 digest=sha256:deadbeefcafef00d...

carla_nguyen: smoke tests passed (latency/throughput within expected).

maya_kapoor: approved to promote to 50% traffic after 10m of canary stability.

deploy-bot: promotion scheduled: ramp to 50% at +10m, full at +30m if no regressions. rollbacks configured to previous-tag=release-2026-03-06 digest=sha256:feedface1234...

alice_gomez: marking thread resolved unless issues. thanks everyone. :shipit:

deploy-bot: Finished: image push succeeded and canary promoted to 50% traffic. commit=a1b2c3d tag=release-2026-03-20 digest=sha256:deadbeefcafef00d...
